description: Every election, people show up at the polls and find out their registration never followed them to their new address. Here's how to check, how to fix it before October 18, and what to do if you miss the deadline.

title: Are You Registered Where You Live Right Now? Here's How to Check in Five Minutes. — Carina Santa Maria for Illinois State Senate
